data.one_liner: Detect which browser and version is in use on Flutter Web.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter Web applications to detect the current browser name and version using the user agent string. It provides safe alternative methods for non-web platforms as well as a way to parse custom user agent strings.
use_when: You need to conditionally adjust web application behavior based on the user's browser.
You need to log or display browser information in a Flutter web application.
avoid_when: You have other, more reliable ways to handle platform or feature detection (like feature testing), as user agent detection is never completely reliable.
Your application primarily targets non-web platforms.
strengths: Supports detection via `Browser.detectOrNull()` for cross-platform safety.
Supports custom user agent parsing via `Browser.detectFrom()`.
weaknesses: Browser detection using UserAgent strings is never completely reliable.
Does not support all current or past browsers out of the box.
